title: Sleep inaccuracy
body:
Is it possible to edit the sleep please? My cat (a creature of habit) routinely wakes me up at 5am each morning. On days off I resettle her and go back to sleep for another hour or more. This additional time is never recorded.
Please make medication dosages changeable. It’s annoying having to end the current regime and starting from scratch with the new, when only the dose has changed. 
Please provide a twice a week dosage regime for progesterone (and probably other drugs too).
author: PollyCG

title: Let me delete my data.
body: Would be great if I could delete this app. I want to free up over 4gb of space and I cannot delete the data from this app. Please make it easier to wipe the data from this app, or to disable it.

title: Stop developing the app and introduce AI
body:
Hi team,
My iPhone collects data from Oura ring, smart scales, xiaomi smart band, BT Grapher, iPhone itself. Give me an option to prioritize sources of data and start analyzing it the same way Whoop does it. 
I can pay extra for recommendations, the same way I pay for iCloud and Apple Music.

author: Jane Dilbert

title: Appreciate this app. Can it be slightly tweaked please?
body: Really appreciate the Cycle Tracking app! My only complaint is that the list of “Symptoms” needs MORE symptom options for tracking as the list is limited. Could you please include the option to include unlimited “other” symptoms that we can manually add/type in??? Or could you add in Anxiety, Muscle Weakness, (like loose grip/dropping things), ruminating, heart palpitations, racing thoughts, vision issues, lethargy, swollen/heavy eyelids, hyperactivity, flu-like symptoms, body temperature changes, rejection sensitivity, paranoia, weepiness, weight gain, weight loss, hopelessness. That would be really helpful for those who suffer from PMDD. Thank you!

title: All I want is an alarm
body: Why does Apple include the alarm feature in this bloated app? I just want to use the standalone alarm.
author: Casual Cole

title: Cycle tracking limitations
body: There are a couple of features that would allow the cycle tracking feature to be more useful. 1. The ability to add other symptoms. 2. Adding PCOS and endometriosis as ‘factors’. And 3. Having light, light-med, med, med-heavy, and heavy as flow options.
author: ReneeNZ001

title: Some data analysis improvement needed
body: Sleep is only calculated when sleep focus is on, you have to get an app like auto sleep to use the same data that Apple collects, but yet somehow manages to translate that to record naps and time after sleep focus is turned off, sleep focus just means you don’t want to be disturbed it doesn’t mean you don’t sleep past that time. And with all the data collected, the only way you can tell whether someone is standing is if they move their arms, that is not a measurement of standing, the stand metrics are even less reliable than the sleep ones.

body: I was using this app to record my blood pressure. Worked great for three weeks and then suddenly all my data is gone. Nothing has changed in terms of iCloud accounts or devices I’m using. It’s just gone. Useless Apple. I’ll use a damn spreadsheet instead.

body: This app is fine, within reason, and in some cases, it’s very good, but there’s one flaw that always annoys me a bit. title: Would love it to have iPad/Mac support!
body: Personally, I love apples, especially here I love apple health. The synchronization with the Apple Watch, fitness, as well as a variety of health apps makes it an amazing hub to be able to review your lifestyle and build a healthier version of yourself from every angle. However, one big downfall for me is the lack of support for Mac and iPad. It would be far easier to have your main hub for reviewing your progress using one of these machines and make the entire experience feel far more put together and programmable than just on your phone.
